subtitle: Adds a free camera, so you can fly around the world and line up screenshots.
description:
Press INSERT to switch it on. The game pauses and the UI hides. Pausing only works in offline saves. Press INSERT or ESC to go back to where you were. The free camera does not work in the main menu.

Every key can be changed in the Mods tab of the game's settings, along with whether it pauses the game and hides the UI, and the mouse sensitivity. There is no controller button to switch it on by default, so set one there if you play on controller.

Keyboard and mouse: - Hold the left or right mouse button and move the mouse to look around - WASD to move - SPACE to go up, CTRL to go down - SHIFT to move faster, ALT to move slower - Scroll wheel to change the speed - Zoom out with - and zoom in with = - HOME to pause and unpause the game

Controller: - Left stick to move, right stick to look around - RT to go up, LT to go down - RB to move faster, LB to move slower - D-pad left and right to change the speed - D-pad up to zoom in, D-pad down to zoom out - Y to pause and unpause the game

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the FreeCam folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\FreeCam\FreeCam_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the FreeCam folder from ~mods.
